data.one_liner: A Flutter ListView that implicitly animates list changes and supports item reordering.
data.what_it_does: It calculates the differences between two lists using the MyersDiff algorithm and automatically animates insertions, removals, updates, and reorderings. It includes custom widgets like ImplicitlyAnimatedList, ImplicitlyAnimatedReorderableList, and sliver variants.
use_when: You need a ListView that smoothly animates items when list data changes.
You want reorderable list items with smooth custom animations and handle triggers.
You want to calculate list differences automatically via the MyersDiff algorithm.
avoid_when: You are rendering extremely large lists where background diff computation causes performance overhead.
You only need standard static lists without item insertion or removal animations.
strengths: Automatically handles item insertions, removals, and updates with animations.
Computes diffs on a background isolate by default to keep the UI thread smooth.
weaknesses: Package is in an early phase with limited testing for long-term stability.
Computing diffs on very large lists can take significant time.
